name: momentrix-icm-kap-toolkit
description: Drop a verifiable context layer onto any project. Scaffolds or retrofits the ICM five-layer folder architecture (IDENTITY.md, routing CONTEXT.md, _config rule books, numbered stage job cards), adds a Karpathy-style raw/ and wiki/ knowledge pair where every fact traces back to a source, and keeps all of it honest with POSIX sh scripts that never delete or rewrite anything you wrote.
